Changes: rewritten with the wiki's center tag, which shows as a centred block, instead of a div with the "center" class; no style option, since the wiki lets no style attribute through; no check for unknown parameters (Lua) or tracking categories; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Center|This text is centred.}}
Example: {{Center|[b]A centred heading line[/b]}}
Expect: A centred heading line
